objective: Implement the canonical deterministic systems-engineering spine consumed by Luzione UI and Sultan OS: ownership, contracts, source-of-truth metadata, identity/correlation, failure semantics, receipts, reconciliation, observability, SLOs, service operations, release evidence, performance, recovery, security evidence, engineering portal, cross-system journeys and production-readiness certification.

stop_codes.S1_IRREVERSIBLE_EXTERNAL_EFFECT: Stop immediately before an actual external/destructive effect if no already-tested recovery path can restore materially equivalent internal and affected external state.
stop_codes.S2_MATERIAL_TRUTH_OR_PRODUCT_CONFLICT: Stop when incompatible canonical meanings remain and repository evidence cannot safely select one.
stop_codes.S3_UNQUARANTINABLE_SYSTEM_FAILURE: Stop when repair budget plus strategy reset are exhausted and the defect threatens integrity or blocks all useful work and cannot be isolated.
stop_codes.S4_QUEUE_EXHAUSTED: Stop when every admitted project is complete, quarantined or removed and no dependency-ready work remains.

queue.title: Cross-System Topology and Ownership Inventory
queue.core_outcome: Inventory actual services, deployables, stores, providers, health sources, dependencies and semantic owners across the API repository and existing published cross-system contracts. Reconcile duplicates before adding new platform machinery.

queue.title: Shared Contract Registry and Compatibility Law
queue.core_outcome: Establish the canonical versioned registry for shared envelopes, commands, events, receipts, failures, state, service metadata and compatibility rules; expose/generate OpenAPI for HTTP contracts where practical without rewriting stable endpoints merely for style.

queue.title: Source-of-Truth and Consistency Registry
queue.core_outcome: Create the canonical mapping for major entities and projections to truth owner, store/provider, mutation owner, read models, consistency, reconciliation, conflict strategy and version identity. Detect duplicate write ownership explicitly.

queue.title: Universal Request Identity and Correlation Envelope
queue.core_outcome: Converge request, correlation, trace, actor, tenant, purpose, capability, authority, contract version and idempotency context at the API boundary while preserving fail-closed server-derived authority.

queue.title: Universal Failure Taxonomy and Retry Contract
queue.core_outcome: Map stable domain/class/retry/severity semantics across API endpoints and provider adapters, preserving bounded provider details while giving UI and Sultan one machine-readable failure contract.

queue.title: Universal Decision, Action, Execution and Readback Receipts
queue.core_outcome: Converge receipt semantics so intent, approval, execution, provider acknowledgement, authoritative readback, recovery and release evidence are addressable and never conflated.

queue.title: Desired, Observed and Reconciliation State Contract
queue.core_outcome: Define and implement shared desired/observed/freshness/reconciliation semantics for provider, service and workflow state so configuration cannot masquerade as observed health.

queue.title: OpenTelemetry-Compatible Observability Spine
queue.core_outcome: Create stable trace propagation, structured redacted logs and metrics from API entrypoint through canonical owners/readback without making telemetry a second business truth store.

queue.title: Service Catalog, Dependency Graph and Runbook Registry
queue.core_outcome: Publish discoverable service identity, owner, tier, repository/runtime, dependencies, contracts, truth scope, SLO refs, runbooks, dashboards and deployment identity; accept consumer records through versioned handoff rather than guessed metadata.

queue.title: SLI, SLO and Error-Budget Framework
queue.core_outcome: Define measurable platform, capability and business SLIs with windows, targets, measurement sources, ownership, alert/runbook links and error-budget semantics. Keep zero-tolerance security controls separate from ordinary availability targets.

queue.title: Production Truth and Readiness Evidence Model
queue.core_outcome: Make status derivable from observed evidence with explicit source, freshness, threshold, impact, owner and evidence tier. Preserve distinctions among configured, bounded, preview-proven and production-observed states.

queue.title: Deployment Provenance, Canary and Rollback Contract
queue.core_outcome: Bind candidate SHA, deployment, contract/migration versions, verification, canary observations, rollback capability, promotion decision and production observation into an auditable release record.

queue.title: Performance, Capacity, Load and Soak Program
queue.core_outcome: Create reproducible baseline, burst, sustained-load, provider-slowdown, database-pool-pressure and recovery workloads with p50/p95/p99, errors, saturation and capacity claims bound to exact evidence.

queue.title: Backup, Restore, DR, RPO and RTO Program
queue.core_outcome: Inventory current backup/restore ownership, define RPO/RTO by critical scope, perform disposable restore drills when safe, verify integrity/readback and record measured recovery evidence without touching production destructively.

queue.title: Security Control Evidence and Zero-Tolerance Invariants
queue.core_outcome: Unify machine-readable evidence for tenant isolation, authority/effect boundaries, secret posture and denial probes while preserving least privilege and preventing sensitive evidence leakage.

queue.title: API Engineering Portal and Contract Explorer
queue.core_outcome: Turn api.luzione.com into an engineering control surface for services, contracts, errors, events, dependencies, SLOs, release/readiness evidence and safe bounded request exploration without exposing secrets or granting authority.

queue.title: Causal Trace and Receipt Navigation Contract
queue.core_outcome: Provide stable authorized navigation from request/business state to causal events, receipts, traces and source readback so consumers can answer why a state exists without code inspection.

queue.title: Test Taxonomy and Harness Consolidation
queue.core_outcome: Map API suites into UNIT/CONTRACT/INTEGRATION/JOURNEY/RELIABILITY/SECURITY/PERFORMANCE/PRODUCTION_VERIFICATION classes, converge redundant orchestration and preserve sensitivity/coverage rather than deleting tests for cosmetic simplicity.

queue.title: Cross-System Certified Journeys
queue.core_outcome: Consume independent UI and Sultan handoffs and certify representative exact-contract journeys including negative, failure, retry/recovery and authoritative readback. Never mark consumer integration complete from producer evidence alone.

queue.title: Production Readiness Certification
queue.core_outcome: Produce machine-readable and human-readable readiness certification by critical invariant with latest exact evidence, owner, failures, recovery posture, release tier and remaining uncertainty. Unsupported finality must remain impossible to express as a pass.
